# Universe24

> One line of whole-number arithmetic on a cubic lattice of Nodes, Rule3 in the law's flux form, read through clicks: the formulas it shares with nature and adds. A paper archived on Zenodo and at the tag v1.1.0, its supplement with every proof, the law of the lattice, the derivations as scripts, the engine of one Node with its tests and the paper's engine at the tag v1.1.0, and one world, Universe24: one Node, one universe file of three integers, the board a torus seeded with light, every family born at the click, the record read through the clicks by one decoder (examples/events/universe24/). Author: Alon Gonen, independent researcher, Haifa, Israel (ORCID 0009-0008-2701-4599). Licence MIT. Permanent record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466436 (the concept DOI of the releases from 3.0.0 on, resolving to the latest version; the versions 1.1.0 to 2.1.0 under https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23190113); the current software version, 4.0.0, Universe24: one Node, one universe, under the concept DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466436 (no release is tagged for 4.0.0 by the owner's word of 2026-10-24, 23:5x UTC; the version number stands in the files, the concept DOI resolves to the latest Zenodo deposit (3.0.0)); 3.0.0: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466437

## In plain words

Suppose nature is discrete: space is made of Node-clocks, and between one Node-clock and the next nothing moves faster than light. A cubic centimetre then holds an astronomical number of Node-clocks, so no centre can know and decide for all of them; each Node-clock acts on its own, by a rule of its own, seeing only itself and its six neighbours. Universe24 is that rule: one line of whole-number arithmetic with no free number but the universe's three integers, den, the full rate and the whole piece's action. A Node-clock holds, for every train of the universe, its notch now, its notch one tick before, and a remainder; at every tick it forms one sum, twice its notch now less its notch before at the teeth count, plus what crosses its six Meshes at each Mesh's reach, less its own mass term, zero for light, plus the carried remainder, and divides by the teeth count; the quotient is its next notch and the new remainder is kept. Nothing is lost, so the rule is exactly reversible. The rule is on whole numbers of any size and carries no bound; the bound is the engine's, from the width of its integers, derived. The tick is the count of rounds and no Node-clock reads it. The trains are derived from den: light, the holder of the volume and the holder of the sign, and one plane train per point of den's circle; the reach of a Mesh comes from the train's pair, the Node-clock's rates and the Mesh's tension, the mass of a Node-clock from the pair and the rates. A world that declares nothing is seeded with light at one quantum on every Node-clock of the torus, and the great clock reads itself: where two whole quanta stand at a Node-clock a pair of matter is born there, the Node-clock's own read of itself and its six Meshes, one Mesh and one number, drawing the whether and picking the fitted hands among den's primes' lifts; the hole is the exact take, and a refusal is a logged line. A Node-clock does not know trains; they come out through the click, and one reckoner names them from the clicks. The click is the one act with a direction; every other act is a bijection, and a Node-clock at the top of its own time gear turns, its two notches exchanged; what the great clock shows of a return is read from the chart's clicks and named (docs/FURTHER_RESEARCH.md, first). The paper's one claim: the rule helps compute things in nature. Every number in the paper is reproduced by a script in the repository.

## Read first

- [The paper, 40 pages](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/papers/one_rule/Universe24_Paper.pdf): "Universe24: one simple rule, the formulas it shares with nature and adds" (Alon Gonen, 2026)
- [The supplement, Online Resource 1, 85 pages](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/papers/one_rule/Universe24_Supplement.pdf): the claims list and the algebraic steps of every derivation
- [The time paper, 22 pages](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/papers/spacetime_events/Universe24_Discrete_Spacetime_of_Events_Paper.pdf): "A discrete spacetime of events in whole numbers: why clocks slow, why nothing outruns light, and why time has a direction only where something was measured" (Alon Gonen, 2026), its source, run and checks in papers/spacetime_events/, built and run by its build.sh
- [README](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/README.md): the aim, the law in three paragraphs, the one calibre and the one world, how to run it, the pages, the six checks read from the clicks, the former courses by name, the words from the law

## The documents

- [The law of the lattice](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/ALGEBRA.md): the project's six postulates at its head in one place (the many Node-clocks with no centre and the locality they force; whole numbers for the reversibility of time; the speed of light at most; nature cyclic and no information lost; the Node-clock with no if; rates multiplying along a gear train, so the time gear's law linear in the logarithm of the rate), then one algebraic line per rule, every clause dated and the old kept by name, the one Node-clock, the click's read of the great clock, the great clock reading itself, the trains at the click, the volume holder and the turnover
- [The decisions in force](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/HIGHLIGHTS.md): the owner's words of 2026-10-24 one line each, and the day's structure in the law's own words with its dated clause by heading
- [The clock concepts, defined](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/CLOCK_WORDS.md): the one dictionary of the clock words and of the concepts every document uses (Node-clock, Mesh, gear, hand, train, kind, composite clock, carry, click, turnover, bang), each defined once in English with the clause that states it and its status
- [Further research](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/FURTHER_RESEARCH.md): what does not match nature, by name, first; then the one world's open items with where to start; the former courses' items named and struck, their text kept in the file's history
- [Follow-up papers](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/FOLLOW_UP_PAPERS.md): the papers the project proposes next, from the careful to the bold, each with its one question, what the project has in the law's status words, and the run or derivation it needs
- [The engine](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/ENGINE.md): the words, the main loop and Rule3 in the law's flux form with the tick's acts, the files, the output, the gates, how to run a world, the known issues and the open items
- [Contributing](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/CONTRIBUTING.md): forks and pull requests, the ground rules, the checks, how to report an error or a failed reproduction
- [What changed](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/CHANGELOG.md): one entry per version, 4.0.0 Universe24, one Node-clock, one universe (the pushes of 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-24, PUSH 1 to 39, by sha, grouped by theme, the branches' bullets below them), 3.0.0 the click as one act, the spin and the atom, 2.1.0 the step in the law's flux form, 2.0.0 the engine V2 against 1.1.0, the paper's engine

## The code

- [Repository on GitHub](https://github.com/Closer24/Universe24): the derivations as scripts (tools/derivations/), the implementation (src/event_universe/), the tests that prove the Node-clock's law (tests/), the one world (examples/events/universe24/) with its logs and pages, the one reckoner (tools/clicks_read.py with tools/look/captions.py), and the former courses' folders under examples/events/ as frozen records
- [Zenodo record](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466436): the concept DOI of the releases from 3.0.0 on, the permanent record and the one to cite, resolving to the latest version (the versions 1.1.0 to 2.1.0 under [10.5281/zenodo.23190113](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23190113)); the current software version, 4.0.0, Universe24: one Node-clock, one universe, stands under the concept DOI with no version record (no release is tagged for 4.0.0 by the owner's word of 2026-10-24, 23:5x UTC; the version number stands in the files, the concept DOI resolves to the latest Zenodo deposit (3.0.0)); 3.0.0, the click as one act, the spin and the atom, is [10.5281/zenodo.23466437](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466437); the paper's engine, version 1.1.0, is 10.5281/zenodo.23202100
